verdict.rationale: Runloop is an API-driven sandbox platform, so asking about versioned APIs and a deprecation policy is a fair question and the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents API versioning or any deprecation policy. The SDK, CLI and llms.txt items cover other capabilities, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
